demo.message: L5: 🔴 bug: `applyDiscount` applies the discount a second time, returning 81% of the original price for a 10% discount. Return `discounted` directly.

ocellus.message: L73: 🟡 risk: `AbortSignal.timeout` may be unavailable in older Node.js or browser runtimes. Provide a fallback using `AbortController` with a manual setTimeout or polyfill.
L33: 🔴 bug: Spreading `env` when it may be undefined throws a TypeError. Replace with `env: { ...baseEnv, ...(env ?? {}) }`.
L115: 🔴 bug: `Buffer.concat(chunks)` receives Uint8Array elements, causing a TypeError. Convert each chunk to a Buffer first, e.g. `Buffer.concat(chunks.map(c => Buffer.from(c)))`.

L311: 🟡 risk: `formatUsd(p.costUsd)` is called without checking for `undefined`. If `p.costUsd` is undefined, `formatUsd` may produce `$NaN` or throw. Guard the value before formatting, e.g., `p.costUsd !== undefined ? formatUsd(p.costUsd) : ''`.

L215: 🔵 nit: `hasSuggestion` regex requires a preceding newline before the backticks, so a suggestion block at the very start of a file is ignored. Adjust the pattern to allow start‑of‑string, e.g., `/^(?:?
)?(`{4,})suggestion?
([\s\S]*?)?
\1/`.
L23: 🟡 risk: `timeoutMs` <= 0 is silently replaced with the default 30 000 ms, which may hide caller intent. Preserve zero/negative values or explicitly reject them.
L27: 🟡 risk: `AbortSignal.timeout` is not available in Node versions prior to v15, causing a runtime TypeError. Use a polyfill or implement timeout via `AbortController` and `setTimeout`.
L115: 🔵 nit: Capture listeners added in `_attachCaptureTaps` are never removed, potentially leaking event handlers if a driver is reused. Detach listeners in a driver teardown method.

L276: 🔴 bug: `archiveManifest` writes to a non‑existent directory, causing an unhandled exception. Ensure the target directory exists (e.g., `await mkdir(dir, { recursive: true })` before calling `writeAtomicJson`.

L150: 🟡 risk: `maskFindingMessage` omits the required emoji and severity prefix, breaking the expected finding message format. Restore the prefix (`${adjudicated ? '🔴 bug' : '🟡 risk'}`) in the returned string.
L124: 🔴 bug: IPv6 unspecified address `[::]` is treated as loopback. It is not a loopback address, so the check should not return true. Remove `[::]` from the loopback condition.
L122: 🔴 bug: IPv6 loopback check compares `host` to `'[::1]'` and `'[::]'`. `URL.hostname` strips brackets, so the comparison never matches. Compare to `'::1'` (and drop `'[::]'`).

L130: 🔴 bug: IPv4‑mapped IPv6 regex includes brackets (`/^\[::ffff:...\]$/`). `URL.hostname` does not contain brackets, so IPv4‑mapped loopback addresses are not detected. Remove the surrounding `\[` and `\]` from the pattern.
L215: 🔴 bug: `laneStart` for the flow lane omits the `startedAt` argument, causing inaccurate start timestamps. Include `startedAt` when invoking `laneStart`.
L237: 🔴 bug: `laneStart` for app/a0 lanes is called without `startedAt`, losing lane start time data. Add the missing `startedAt` argument.

demo.message: L6: 🔴 bug: percentage applied twice — a 10% discount returns 0.81× the price instead of 0.90×. Remove the second `(1 - pct / 100)` factor.
L2: 🟡 risk: example value uses the live-mode format `sk_live_`, normalizing prod-shaped secrets in a committed file and tripping secret scanners. Use a `sk_test_` placeholder.

L8: 🔵 nit: AWS credentials go in the shell while `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` lives in `.env`, splitting config across two sources. Add `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID`/`AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` placeholders to `.env.example`.

ocellus.message: L34: 🟡 risk: default 120s cap aborts slow-but-healthy completions (large-context/reasoning models regularly exceed 2min non-streaming), turning success into spurious failure. Raise the default or allow `complete` to override per call, e.g. accept `timeoutMs` in the completion opts.

L138: 🟡 risk: classified CliError message drops the aggregate `errors` detail, so a mixed multi-model failure surfaces as a single provider message with no per-candidate context. Include the joined messages in the CliError message or set `cause` to an aggregate Error.

L82: 🔵 nit: `_request` spread clobbers any `init.signal`, so a caller-supplied AbortSignal is silently ignored. Compose signals (`AbortSignal.any([init.signal, AbortSignal.timeout(this._timeoutMs)])`) or document that `init.signal` is unsupported.

L136: ❓ q: does `pickProviderError` classify the `TimeoutError` DOMException from `AbortSignal.timeout`? If not, a pure-timeout failure falls through to the generic aggregate and can't be retried by class.

L299: 🟡 risk: `P_FALLBACK_GATE = 0.7` is a magic constant duplicated across the action and `src/cli.ts` with only a comment to keep them in sync; any one drifting silently changes which findings count as high-confidence. Move it to a shared module and import it in all three sites.

L350: 🔵 nit: `files` can contain `undefined` when a reproduced finding has no `file`, so `files.size === 1` renders the lead as `N findings reproduced in \`\``. Filter out undefined files (`.filter((file) => file !== undefined)`) before the size check.

L92: 🔴 bug: `child.exitCode !== null` is false when the child dies by signal (Node sets `signalCode`, leaves `exitCode` null), so a signal-killed child passes the squatter check and the run binds evidence to a server it didn't start — exactly what this guard was added to prevent. Check `child.exitCode !== null || child.signalCode !== null`, or record which of `ready`/`childExited` won the race and treat a `childExited` win as terminal regardless.
L91: 🔵 nit: unconditional 250ms sleep runs even when `childExited` won the race (child already dead) — wasted delay before an inevitable throw. Track the race winner and only defer when `ready` won.

L148: 🔴 bug: `requestfailed` also fires for aborted requests — navigation-cancelled fetches and teardown-time aborts report `net::ERR_ABORTED`, so every route change and `context.close()` pollutes captures with non-failures. Skip when `req.failure()?.errorText` is `net::ERR_ABORTED` (and `net::ERR_TIMED_OUT` on page close).
ocellus.suggestion:
const failure = req.failure()?.errorText ?? 'failed'
      if (failure === 'net::ERR_ABORTED') return
      this._addCapture('request-failed', failure, url)

ocellus.message: L82: 🔵 nit: `exploreActionSchema` enum omits `done` from `strict` schema property constraints while `ExploreAction.action` union includes `done` — wait, `done` is present; but `fail` in the `ExploreAction` union has no prompt line and no schema entry, so a model can never emit it and the type is dead weight in the vocabulary union. Drop `fail` from `ExploreAction` or document who sets it.

L285: ❓ q: `archiveManifest` writes into `<reportDir>/manifests` without creating it — verify `writeAtomicJson` mkdirs, otherwise the first-ever archive throws ENOENT and the rejection propagates to the caller. Add `await mkdir(dir, { recursive: true })` before the write if `writeAtomicJson` does not.

L288: 🔵 nit: sanitizer `[\w.-]` keeps `.` but not path separators, so `..` collapses into a literal `...json` filename — safe today; document that or also strip leading dots for defense in depth (`safeName.replace(/^\.+/, '')`).

L119-133: 🔵 nit: `buildRunReport` grew three trailing positional optionals including a boolean — call sites become unreadable (`buildRunReport(tests, t, d, [], true, nonce)`). Take an options object `{ extraCalls, exploreEvidence, runNonce }`.
L138: 🔵 nit: `[...tests.flatMap((t) => t.calls), ...extraCalls]` is materialized twice and walked twice. Build the combined array once and fold `tokens` into the existing loop.
ocellus.suggestion:
const allCalls = [...tests.flatMap((t) => t.calls), ...extraCalls]
let visionTokens = 0
for (const c of allCalls) {
  callsByModel[c.model] = (callsByModel[c.model] ?? 0) + 1
  costByModel[c.model] = (costByModel[c.model] ?? 0) + c.costUsd
  visionTokens += c.tokens
}

ocellus.message: L292: 🔵 nit: prune filters only by `.json` extension, so any stray `.json` file dropped into `manifests/` is counted toward retention and can evict real archives. Match the archive shape (`/\.json$/` plus the sanitized-name prefix) or use a dedicated subdirectory per run.

L241: 🟡 risk: `done` stamps every `inconclusive` result with summary `delegation returned — self-reported`, so the timeout path (L315) reports a delegation that never returned. Pass `summary` via `extra` on the timeout call and keep the fixed label only for completed delegations.

L262: 🔵 nit: when `version === undefined` but `a0.url` is configured, the lane still runs the 5s host probe and a doomed spawn instead of failing fast. Short-circuit to `unavailable` when `version === undefined`, mirroring the both-missing branch.
L190: 🔵 nit: `new URL(url)` is constructed twice in `isLoopback`. Parse once into a const and reuse for the `file:` check and hostname extraction.
L83: 🔵 nit: bare `undefined` positional arg for cwd in the `exec` call obscures the signature. Use an options object or named `cwd` parameter on `ExecFn` if the seam allows.

L94: ❓ q: stderr regex `/ENOENT|not found|no such file/i` reclassifies any completed run whose stderr happens to contain those phrases (e.g. a0 logging a missing dependency) as `spawnError`, flipping the lane from `inconclusive` to `unavailable`. Is the sniff worth keeping now that `res.spawnError` is authoritative for `defaultExec`?

demo.message: L6: 🔴 bug: `applyDiscount` multiplies by `(1 - pct / 100)` a second time, compounding the discount (10% off returns 81% of price). Return `discounted` unchanged.
L2: 🟡 risk: `.env.example` commits a `sk_live_`-prefixed Stripe key, training contributors to commit live secrets and tripping secret scanners. Use a `sk_test_` placeholder.

ocellus.message: L199: 🟡 risk: `ConfigInput` keeps `a0` as a non-partial `{ url; maxTasks; timeoutMs }`, so TS callers must supply `maxTasks`/`timeoutMs` even though `resolveConfig` treats both as optional. Add a dedicated `a0?: Partial<{...}>` (or a `A0Config` interface) to `ConfigInput`.

L60: 🟡 risk: `settled` is referenced by the `execFile` callback before its `let` declaration; a synchronous callback (or a future refactor) throws a TDZ ReferenceError. Hoist `let settled = false` above the `execFile` call.

L88: 🟡 risk: escalation timer is only cleared on `'close'`, so when a spawn error (ENOENT) fires `error` without `close` the timer still runs and can `resolve()` a second time after the callback already resolved. Clear `escalate` in the execFile callback too, or guard with `settled` before clearing.

L466: 🔵 nit: `app.maxSteps`/`app.timeoutMs` are read from `rawApp` while sibling fields read from the merged `app`; a future default would be silently ignored. Read `optPosInt(app.maxSteps)`/`optPosInt(app.timeoutMs)` for consistency.
L455: 🔵 nit: `app.task` keeps untrimmed value while `sanitizeExpectation` trims its markers — a padded task string is stored verbatim. Assign `app.task.trim()`.
L141: 🔵 nit: the byte cap is checked after pushing, so up to `chunkSize-1` extra bytes past 65_536 are buffered/decoded. Slice the final chunk to `65_536 - received` before pushing.
L492: 🔵 nit: a whitespace-only `a0.url` (e.g. `'  '`) passes the `!== ''` check and becomes the base URL. Use `a0.url.trim() !== ''` and store the trimmed value.

L282: 🔴 bug: `keep` is compared against `names.length` read *after* the new file is written, so when `keep` equals the pre-existing count the oldest archive is pruned immediately; retention should bound the total including the new entry, or the count should be computed before the write. Read `readdir` first, then write, then prune against `names.length - keep + 1`.

L268: 🟡 risk: sanitizing with `replace(/[^\w.-]/g, '-')` is not injective — distinct runIds (`a/b` and `a-b`) collapse to the same filename and silently overwrite each other's archive; append a short hash of the raw runId to keep names unique.
L199: 🔵 nit: single line exceeds the repo print width and bypasses the multi-line style used by the surrounding branches; wrap it like the `validation` branch.

L83: ❓ q: comment claims the explore video is "also in `artifacts.videos`", but `buildRunReport` only maps `tests[].videoPath` — confirm the caller appends `explore.videoPath` to `artifacts.videos`, otherwise the claim is false and the video is unreachable via the documented field.

L195: 🔴 bug: empty-string `a0.url` is excluded by `configured` (so `resolveHost()` runs) yet `??` keeps `host = ''` and sets `hostSource = 'config'`, so a resolvable host is discarded and the lane reports `unavailable`. Select host/source off `configured` instead of `!== undefined`.

L218: 🟡 risk: `maxTasks` is read only for the `note` string — the lane always calls `runA0Task` once, so `a0.maxTasks: 0` still spends a delegation and the logged "max N" is false. Gate on `maxTasks > 0` (or loop up to `maxTasks`) before delegating.

L143: 🔵 nit: `done()` forces `summary` to "delegation returned — self-reported" for every `inconclusive`, so the timeout path (L240) reports a return that never happened. Allow the caller to pass a `summary` override in `extra`.

L88: 🔵 nit: the `/ENOENT|not found|no such file/i` stderr sniff can tag a completed run as `spawnError` — exactly the misclassification the comment forbids. Drop the sniff and treat missing `res.spawnError` as `false` for injected execs.

L12: 🔵 nit: `writeAtomicText` leaks the `.tmp` file when `rename` throws (EACCES/EXDEV), leaving orphaned temps in the evidence dir. Wrap `writeFile`/`rename` in try/catch with `unlink(tmp).catch(() => {})`.

L252: 🟡 risk: `laneDetailBudget` sets `exceeded` from `overLimit(detail.visionCostUsd, budget.limitUsd)` but never assigns `spentUsd` from `detail.visionCostUsd`, so the manifest reports `spentUsd: 0` alongside `exceeded: true` for runners that only emit scalar totals. Set `spentUsd: detail.visionCostUsd` when `detail.calls === undefined`.

L419-421: 🟡 risk: a valid `detailStatus` overrides the exit code unconditionally, so a runner that writes `status: 'passed'` and then exits non-zero (post-processing failure, crash after write) yields a passing lane. Gate the override on `code === 0` for `'passed'`, e.g. `detailStatus === 'passed' && code !== 0 ? 'failed' : (detailStatus ?? ...)`.

L597: 🟡 risk: `probe.content.slice(0, PROBE_CONTENT_CAP)` truncates by UTF-16 code units, so multi-byte content exceeds the byte cap and can split a surrogate pair. Encode with `TextEncoder`/`Buffer.byteLength` and slice on a code-point boundary.

L160: 🟡 risk: `totals.visionCalls ?? usage.calls` lets an explicit `0` in `totals.visionCalls` overwrite a non-empty per-test call count, so usage under-reports when a runner emits totals without call counts. Fall back when the total is falsy: `totals.visionCalls || usage.calls`.

L178: 🔵 nit: `flowEvidenceRan`'s doc comment claims an errored explore pass also fails closed, but the check only inspects `explore.skipped`; either extend `FlowReport.explore` with an error/outcome field and check it, or drop the 'errored' claim from the comment.
